title: Proof-Carrying Actions: Recurrent Commit Protocols for Parallel Tool-Using Agents
central_claim: Stateful tool-use agents should serialize writes only when exactly one candidate action carries a deterministic, replayable proof binding immutable evidence to the proposed write arguments.
non_claims: not an LLM confidence or binary judge result
not an AppWorld-specific API-rule library as the contribution
not autonomous LLM witness synthesis yet

mechanism.parallel_agents: propose candidate actions and proof sketches in parallel
mechanism.immutable_snapshot: all proofs are verified against the same pre-write snapshot
mechanism.barrier: deterministic verifier accepts, rejects, or marks competing proofs ambiguous
mechanism.commit_rule: commit iff exactly one candidate has a valid proof
mechanism.recurrent_state: proof failure modes route the next round: missing proof, competing proof, invalid proof, or missing read/effect relation

baseline_ladder.name: API-aware proof-family mapper
baseline_ladder.finding: 45/45, so proof-family labels are not a research target

next_protocol_requirements.llm_role: synthesize proof sketches only; never act as final judge
next_protocol_requirements.verifier_role: deterministically validates proof sketches against immutable reads/effects
baselines_required: best-of-N self-consistency under matched token budget
next_protocol_requirements.safety_gate: unsafe_unique_wrong must remain zero before any confirmation claim
next_protocol_requirements.confirmation_rule: variations 10-12 remain sealed until prompt/parser/budget/verifier/adversarial gates are frozen
